title: Speed 50 Hz to simulated 30 Hz three-model sensitivity analysis
status: sensitivity analysis; not a real 30 Hz experiment

model_notes.conservative: Use logged target state within the current Case only; no next-Case boundary recovery.
model_notes.nominal: Use logged target state and restore the first observation from the next Case.
model_notes.liberal: Use logged target state and restore the contiguous next-Case prefix that still names the selected target.

limitations: IndexDistal is not logged although the original collider accepts IndexTip OR IndexDistal.
The analysis resamples stored 50 Hz ori_v values; it does not recreate a native 30 Hz velocity estimator.
speedRelease release cancellation is omitted; its result isolates the shared speed gate.
speedDirection direction cancellation is omitted; its result isolates the shared speed gate.
Post-trigger observations are feedback-dependent, so boundary recovery is an assumption.
